title: Польові нотатки
fields_and_relations: Individual field_note document with research, original author/time, optional note title and required text; legacy notebook provenance retained.
required_interaction: Research list → note modal → detail/edit; team reads, author edits; no session/group controls.

implementation.view_model: Research notes list, body/title/author search, author filter, one creation/edit modal, immutable authorship and date, revision history.
limitations: Browser-local prototype; real authenticated team access and cross-device offline synchronization require the backend implementation.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; fixture version 9
permissions: field.write or catalog.write in archive scope; vocabulary.write for terms
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, expected revision, clone, validate, hash, commit. No partial mutation on failure.
